## Phase: 28 - DX Discoverability

### Hook prefix convention
from: [[decision:hook-prefix-nana-namespace]]
retrieved: 2026-05-23

- All hooks adopt [nana:<hook-name>] prefix; exception: [dev-wiki:post-commit] kept as semantic trigger
- [warn] subsumed into [nana:<hook>]; session-start uses sub-prefixes: [nana:gate], [nana:memory], [nana:recovery], [nana:pending], [nana:enforce]

### Status command and MANIFEST
from: [[decision:status-in-install-sh]] + project analysis
retrieved: 2026-05-23

- --status in install.sh (not separate script) — reuses flag parser infrastructure
- MANIFEST descriptions are additive: # comment lines after existing md5+path checksums (115 lines)

### Hook message patterns and eval
from: [[decision:jq-hook-migration]] + [[decision:eval-binary-scoring-only]]
retrieved: 2026-05-23

- 6 distinct message patterns today: [tag], "Blocked:", "Warning:", bare text, "===" headers, JSONL
- jq fail-open guard: `command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0` — 8 hooks use this
- 5 hooks install globally, 6 are project templates
- Eval uses stdout_contains/stderr_contains substring matching — preserve key substrings
